name: Field Value Wrapper
description: The value/control half of the field wrapper pattern: entryValueDiv > control (entry/lkup/dxdtpick/dxnumberbox/...). Always a sibling of atom.field-label-wrapper's entryLabelDiv, both children of the same entryLabelOuterDiv (see molecules/field-*.json for the fully composed pattern).
